title: Glory of God
definition: The glory of God is the radiance, worth, beauty, majesty, and excellence of who God is, revealed in His works, His character, His Word, and supremely in Jesus Christ.
summary: God's glory is the display of His infinite worth, beauty, majesty, and excellence.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the radiance of God's glory, and through Him believers behold God's character, grace, truth, and saving power.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's glory is the display of His infinite worth. Creation declares His glory, Scripture reveals His glory, holiness magnifies His glory, love displays His glory, and redemption in Christ brings His glory into clear focus.

God does not need creation in order to become glorious. He is eternally glorious in Himself. Yet He reveals His glory so that His creatures may know Him, worship Him, trust Him, and live for Him.

The glory of God is seen supremely in Jesus Christ. In Him, grace and truth are revealed. Through His life, death, resurrection, and reign, believers see the beauty of God's holiness, mercy, justice, wisdom, and love.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often live for smaller glories: approval, comfort, success, control, or recognition. The glory of God reorders life around what is truly ultimate. It frees believers from making themselves the center and calls them to worship the One who alone is worthy.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask whether your choices, speech, service, suffering, worship, and relationships honor the Lord. Live not for self-exaltation but for the glory of God. Let the beauty of Christ reshape what you treasure most.
